# Pydantic v2 Hands-On Cookbook

> Interactive bilingual Jupyter & Google Colab notebooks covering Pydantic v2 BaseModel validation, Field constraints, custom validators, discriminated unions…

## Notebooks (en)

- [01. BaseModel Essentials & Type Coercion (Lax vs. Strict)](https://examples.drawlib.com/pydantic/en/01_basemodel_quickstart.html): Pydantic v2 turns standard Python type annotations (class User(BaseModel):) into a blazing-fast, Rust-powered validation and serialization pipeline backed by…
- [02. Field Constraints & Inspecting ValidationError](https://examples.drawlib.com/pydantic/en/02_fields_and_errors.html): Type annotations like int and str guarantee basic shapes, but production payloads also carry domain invariants—positive quantities, bounded SKU formats…
- [03. Custom Validators & Computed Fields](https://examples.drawlib.com/pydantic/en/03_validators_and_computed.html): Built-in Field(...) constraints cover numeric bounds, lengths, and regex patterns, while custom Python domain logic hooks into four distinct stages…
- [04. Nested Models, Discriminated Unions & JSON Schema](https://examples.drawlib.com/pydantic/en/04_nested_unions_and_schema.html): Real-world REST APIs, webhook event streams, and LLM tool/structured-output contracts rarely validate flat records in isolation. Instead, production systems…

- [04. ネスト構造・判別共用体（Discriminated Union）・JSON Schema](https://examples.drawlib.com/pydantic/ja/04_nested_unions_and_schema.html): 実務の REST API、Webhook イベントストリーム、および LLM のツール呼び出し／構造化出力では、単一のフラットなモデルだけで完結することは稀です。本番システムでは ネストされた BaseModel 階層 を組み立て、タグ付き判別共用体（Field(discriminator=...) +…
